metadata.name: GetClearing
metadata.description: Use this API to post Debit or credit adjustments to account. If due to any check transction is declined then force post option can be used to bypass the check.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Branch code from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1006 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: TransactionCode
request_fields.description: This tag indicates the transction code that is displayed after a transaction is executed. Example: ABC14433222 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

request_fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Transaction Currency Code Valid Values:0-9 Example:840 Please Refer Appendix Section: Primary Currency Code Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: Notes
request_fields.description: Notes entered by the user Valid Values : A-Z,0-9 Example : Card found Allowable Values: 2000

request_fields.name: NotesReason
request_fields.description: PreDefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: TransactionReference
request_fields.description: Transaction ID of the transaction which needs to be reversed or adjustment is posted against that transaction Condition: It must contain TransactionID of the Original transaction when CMTTranType is either 38,35 or 43. For other  CMTTranType it should be Null. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AllowForcePost
request_fields.description: Provides facility to allow force post as per the value passed. Valid values: 0 = Normal posting with all validations 1 = Only Overdarft ADC, OD Opt in status and Available balance validation will be done 2 =  Force Post transaction (no validations) Example: 0 Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: RetrievalReferenceNumber
request_fields.description: Indicates unique reference number throughout the system. Example: 012541 Allowable Values: 12

request_fields.name: WalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: Mandatory when card product supports MCC wallets.

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
request_fields.description: Name and location details of merchant Valid Values: a-z A-Z Example: Dental merchant, Nashua Allowable Values: 40

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example :  147852369

children.name: AvailableBalance
children.description: In case of the non wallet product,  account available balance will be returned whereas in case of the multi wallet product, wallet available balance will be returned. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 52.25
